In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Omni-scramblers: In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That unit is detected:
- While a unit is detected, that unit has +3" detection range.

Evade and Survive (Once per phase, per unit): In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Evade and Survive (Once per phase, per unit)

Press the Attack: This unit’s melee attacks have:
- [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/vehicle].
- Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, [Sustained Hits 1].

For the Khan!:
- This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]
- This unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
Codex Adept: The assault doctrine, devastator doctrine and tactical doctrine are active for this unit.
Thunderstrike: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.

Drop Pod Assault:
- This unit must start the battle in strategic reserves.
- In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.
- When this unit is set up, all units embarked within this unit must make a disembark/assault disembark move, and those units must be set up more than 8" away from all enemy units.
Storm Shield: This model has a 4+ InSv.
Raise the Banner: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

Spiritual Leader (Once per battle round, per unit): At the start of any phase, you can select one friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6" of this model. That unit is no longer battle-shocked.
Spiritual Leader (Once per battle round, per unit)
Rapid Disembarkation: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends an advance move, units embarked within this unit can make a shock disembark move.
Aggressive Reconnaissance: In your Shooting phase, this unit’s ranged attacks that target an enemy unit that is not within 6" of any other enemy units have +1 to wound rolls.
Honour or Death: When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.
Leader of Astartes: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit, this unit has Lone Operative.
Skilled Riders: This unit has MOBILE.
Command Squad: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to wound rolls.
Assault Ramp: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, units embarked within this unit can make an assault disembark move.

Priority Target Identified (Once per battle, per unit): In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one visible terrain feature. That terrain feature is identified until the end of the turn.
- While an enemy unit is within an identified terrain feature, that enemy unit has +3" detection range.
Priority Target Identified (Once per battle, per unit)
Glory of Ultramar: In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was destroyed by those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Into the Fray: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit’s melee attacks have [cleave 1].

Knight Champion of Macragge (Once per phase, per army): In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6".
Knight Champion of Macragge (Once per phase, per army)
Terror Troops (Aura): While an enemy model is within 3" of this unit, that enemy model has -1 OC.
Honour Guard of Macragge: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to wound rolls.
Rites of Tempering: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Raise the Banner: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.
Strategic Acumen: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one combat doctrine to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Ballistus Strike: This unit’s ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 24" of this unit have [Sustained Hits 1].
Thunderhawk Insertion: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly GRAVIS/PHOBOS/TACTICUS unit. That unit has Deep Strike.
Librarian (psyker level 1): This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.

Trifold Path of Shadow: This unit has:
- Stealth.
- -3" detection range.
Raise the Banner: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

Demi-company Commander (Once per turn, per unit): When a friendly CAPTAIN unit uses its Strategic Acumen ability, you can use this ability. If you do, the selected combat doctrine is active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Demi-company Commander (Once per turn, per unit)

Blessings of the Omnissiah: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this model:
- That VEHICLE model heals D3 wounds.
- That VEHICLE model’s attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.
Librarian (psyker level 1): This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.
Total Obliteration: This unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll damage rolls.
Relic Shield: This model has +1 W.

Calgar’s Champion: This model’s attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can:
- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Signum Array: In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.
Chief Librarian (psyker level 3): This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.
Catechism of Fire: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can select one visible enemy unit. This unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have [Devastating Wounds].
Strategic Acumen: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one combat doctrine to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Librarian (psyker level 1): This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.
Assault Ramp: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, units embarked within this unit can make an assault disembark move.

Bolter Discipline: In your Shooting phase, if any of the following apply, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls:
- This unit is within range of an objective.
- The target of that attack is within range of an objective.

Power of the Machine Spirit: This unit’s ranged attacks can:
- Re-roll one hit roll.
- Re-roll one wound roll.

Unto the Anvil: This unit’s melee attacks can:
- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
- Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls.

Haywire Mine (Once per battle, per unit): In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit and roll one D6. On a 2+:
- That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- Or: If that enemy unit is a VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.
Haywire Mine (Once per battle, per unit)
Meteoric Descent: If this unit made an ingress move this turn, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.
Overlapping Destruction: In your Shooting phase, you can select one enemy unit. This unit’s Heavy Bolter weapons that target that enemy unit have [BLAST 1].
Psychic Hood (Psychic): This unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks.

Demi-company Commander (Once per turn, per unit): When a friendly CAPTAIN unit uses its Strategic Acumen ability, you can use this ability. If you do, the selected combat doctrine is active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Demi-company Commander (Once per turn, per unit)
Raise the Banner: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.
Captain of the Honour Guard: If your army includes a MARNEUS CALGAR unit, replace this unit’s Leader ability with the Support ability (this unit can still be attached to the same units).
Strategic Acumen: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one combat doctrine to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.

Cold and Calculating: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to attack, you can select one of the following for this unit’s attacks to have:
- [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
- Or: [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
- Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle] and [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
Reaping Tally: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 AP.
Master of Shadows: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. You can re-roll charge rolls for that unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Siege Captain: This model’s attacks that target a FORTIFICATION/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S, AP and D.
Combat Shield: This model has 5+ InSv.

Terminatus Assault: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit’s:
- Lightning Claws weapons have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
- Thunder Hammer weapons have [Sustained Hits 1: Monster/Vehicle].

Sentinel Protocols (Once per phase, per unit): You can target this unit with the Fire Overwatch stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
- This unit’s snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ until that stratagem is resolved.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.
Sentinel Protocols (Once per phase, per unit)
Executioner: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit not below half-strength have +1 to hit rolls.
Grav-chutes: This unit has Deep Strike.

Aquilon Optics: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can:
- Re-roll one hit roll.
- Re-roll one wound roll.
- Re-roll one damage roll.
Shield Dome: This unit has 5+ InSv.

Prescience (psychic level 2): In your Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- This unit has +1 Sv until the start of your next turn.

Purgation Run: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do:
- This unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
- This unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Trophy Taker: This unit’s attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can:
